test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CAPABLE : PACELBA :: AUCTION : CUANOIT :: CAREFUL : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Letters are rearranged diagonally.**

CAPABLE : PACELBA →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a66e58589ff8e5424060838c2f0c766d2b6d61e644c1d37653c6d3e12ee3831.png] 

AUCTION : CUANOIT →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13a802677e6b9a96cd84dab0cd5009ca62c1b1d57dd26bcb0f348ea4dd02a1d2.png] 

Similarly, for 'CAREFUL : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f9692276c696ac11b9c78779fd942be9839b96fe24757d5e106169dcb842653.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "RACLUFE".
